S.FORM: == Taypak 101 miawas tu mihcaan miuing tu siwacahay a panpawa == Taypak 101 miawas tu mihcaan siwacahay a panpawa amiuing , "Taipei 101 NewYear Firework", u Taywan Taypak-se a Taypak 101 matatundyhan a luma' namaka 2003 mihcaan, patucek han tu mihcaan tu 12 bulad 31 demiad " miawas tu mihcaan" katukuh tu cila a mihcaan tu 1 bulad 1 demiad " sayaway nu mihcaan" pisulitan nu tukian a patahekal tu silamalay nu panpawa, u piawasan nu Taypak a labui nu nipiuingan nu Taypak salimulakay nu baluhay a mihcaan. :Taipei 101 NewYear Firework) High新年城之壓軸. picidekan u sayaway nu kitakid a nipatideng i matatunduhay nu luma'an a patahekal tu silamalay nu panpawaan. nipikilukan sayaway aitida i matatunduhay a luma'an apakasilamalay tu panpawaan, satalakaway a nipadeng makaala tu 509.2 kunce "1,671 ince", itida i madicemay nu nikatatungduhan, u satalakaway nu kitakid a nipalamalan tu panpawaan, itida i 2015 mihcaan katukuh tu 2016 mihcaan a miuing sa u nipalamalan tu panpawa makaalatu 30,000 a lalacuan, sakaytini i kitakid nu matatungduhay nu laumaan u satalakaway nu kilukan. nikalingatuan, tu mihmihcaan makaala tu lasubu nu wang ku tademaw mutaydaay a miadih, malakitakid atu Taywan sakatinengan nu tataydaan tu miawas nu mihcaan a kawawan. . nipaadih a kawaw 表演流程 tu mihmihcaan a nipaadih a kawaw, namakayda namin tu tuki nu Taypak " CTC+8" 12 bulad 31 demiad tu labii malingatu, Taypak 101 a matatunduhay a luma' nu hekal a cabeng, kanca makayda ku nikatahekalan a paadih, katukuh tu miawas tu mihcaan a misausi tu tuki sa hamawsa a mapaneng, micumud tu sadikuday a sulitan nu tuki, tu mihmihcaan caay namin kalecad i waluay a nikatatungduhan nu luma ku cacay a sasulitan sipakay hekal namaka sasa tapabawsa, misamelimelitan mapaneng itidatu a sakalimulakan, palecad makayda i nikudan ku nipiasipan tu cacay a bataan, katukuh tu sadikuday nu Taypak a tuki tu cacay bulad cacay demiad sep benis sep selic milawit tu baluhay a mihcaan tatengan a malingatu, tawya nikatatungduhan nu hekalan paadih tu silamalay , misatanayu' tu tukian. (UTC+8)12月31 . mangaleb i Taypek sayaway u kunfan ku mikawaway a " miawas tu mihcaan a paimung" sa, palekal tu pilawitan nu mihcaan a paimung. namaka tawya nu kitakidan a saayaway ni patideng tu talakaway nu matatungduhay a luma'an – Taypak 101, mala miawasay tu mihcaan a tataydaan. yu miasip tu namaka nikudan a miasip sa. mahedek tu a namaka nikudan miasip satu, papangpawa tu siwacahay i hekal nu matatungduhay a lumaan " saan tu picapian a mahedek tu 2003 katukuh i 2004 mihcaan tu sipakayda i nikudan miasip tu sapiawas tu mihcaan, itida a cacay i Taypak 101 liklik a papanpawan tu silamalay. nika itini i 2003 mihcaan tu nu ayawan, Taypei-se u se-cen-hu nu ayawan a putahan ku sakasikawaw tu piawasan nu mihcaan a angangangan nu kitidaan. . tu mihmihcaan a kawaw 歷年活動 2003 mihcaan
